Description.SourceString:
Observation log: We have come upon a worthy adversary, Sir. It turns out that, while we are undetectable by seven of the base senses, we may have underestimated the eighth. The cat-people of this region can detect us through their noses, Sir. We lost Agent Gorgonzola to an olfactory mishap.

I hope you don't mind, Sir, but I opened the War Room and initiated Treat Level 5. There were biscuits, cake and anchovies - you would have adored it, Sir. 

Emergency measures were agreed upon. All penguins were required to wash daily, brush any teeth that they might have twice a day, and eat only the least pungent fish. We were to clean the webbing of our flippers and pick the whitebait from our beaks. Roll call in the morning now includes inspections of all extremities. 

Operation Underarm is in full effect.

Threat assessment: High - I'm not sure how long we can keep this degree of hygiene up, Sir.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
